title: My Sister Faked A $1 Sale, Stole Dad's $265K Glass. So I Watched Her Polish With Fraud Gloves.
description: When my father's will left me his $265,000 Depression-era glass collection, my sister forged a one-dollar sale note and sold it to a museum. I recovered every piece and opened Shattered Trust Glass Studio, where she's court-ordered to polish each item wearing white gloves printed with 'Fraud Fragile' while visitors receive a postcard of her perjury conviction. #InheritanceBetrayal #GlassJustice #ShatteredTrust
thumb_text: SHE POLISHES GLASS IN FRAUD FRAGILE GLOVES
